title: Experience certificate
description: Certificate of employment and experience, numbered in the HR certificate series.

params.title: EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE
paragraphs: This is to certify that **{fullName}** was employed with **{company}** from **{startDate}** to **{endDate}**.

paragraphs.text: During this period, {firstName} worked as **{designation}** in the **{department}**.
{firstName} carried out the duties of the role diligently and responsibly, and we found {firstName} to be committed and willing to learn.

paragraphs: We thank {firstName} for their service and wish them continued success in their future career.

fields.name: honorific
fields.label: Honorific
fields.help: Mr., Ms., Dr. … (printed before the name)

fields.name: salutationName
fields.label: Short name
fields.help: Used in the body; default: the first name

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Work summary
fields.help: A paragraph on the work done; replaces the generic paragraph
